title: Kompass: Nazi dictatorship, World War II & new beginning
tip: Read the Kompass first: it gives you the key facts behind every question in this block.

exercises.title: Kompass: Nazi dictatorship, World War II & new beginning (1/2)
exercises.body: The timeline to burn in: **30.01.1933** Hitler appointed Reichskanzler → dictatorship built within months (parties banned, press censored, arbitrary arrests, state racism as program). **09.11.1938** Novemberpogrome, synagogues and Jewish businesses destroyed. **01.09.1939** invasion of Poland starts WWII. **20.07.1944** Stauffenberg's failed assassination attempt = symbol of German resistance. **08.05.1945** unconditional surrender, war ends in Europe. Then: four Allies (USA, UK, France, Soviet Union, never Japan) occupy four zones; Berlin itself split into four sectors. **1948/49** Soviet blockade → Berlin **Luftbrücke**.

exercises.title: Kompass: Nazi dictatorship, World War II & new beginning (2/2)
exercises.body: **1949** double founding: BRD from the three western zones (constitution: Grundgesetz, first Chancellor: **Adenauer**), DDR in the Soviet zone. Adenauer's economics minister Erhard builds the **soziale Marktwirtschaft** → 1950s **Wirtschaftswunder**; 1957 the BRD co-founds the EEC (Römische Verträge →Teil 3). This block is the historical heart of your Loyalitätserklärung, the "besondere historische Verantwortung" clause you'll sign refers to exactly these facts.

exercises.title: Kompass auf Deutsch: NS-Diktatur, Zweiter Weltkrieg & Neubeginn
exercises.body: 1933: Hitler an die Macht → Diktatur (keine freien Wahlen, Parteienverbot, staatlicher Rassismus). 9.11.1938 Pogromnacht. 1939–45 Zweiter Weltkrieg, Ende 8. Mai 1945. Danach 4 Besatzungszonen, 1949 Gründung der Bundesrepublik, erster Kanzler Adenauer. Holocaust leugnen = Straftat.
